items.title: Ray Sherman interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 13, 1998
items.q: I remember working with Nelson Riddle on “L’il Abner”

ctx.x: Yeah one of those kind of things, that’s right, exactly. There’s a name for it, I’ve forgot what they call it. Like a filter that changes pitches and goes up and down the spectrum, kind of like that. Oh the gal sang good, she had good musicians, pretty good tune, for a pop tune. So I did a lot of them. As I say most of them weren’t hits. But I got through it. They probably sold. For Capitol I think mostly I worked. And then I started getting movie calls. I remember working with Nelson Riddle on “L’il Abner” which…
Let’s talk about live T.V. for a moment.
